label: Olive Grove House (fictional demo drawing)

extraction.area_source: Floor totals printed on the plans: ground floor 98.6 m2 + first floor 87.8 m2

narrative: The drawing shows a two-storey family house of about {{area}} m2 (ground floor 98.6 m2 plus first floor 87.8 m2, read from the floor totals), with four bedrooms, three bathrooms and a study. Built as Turnkey Package it comes out at roughly {{turnkey.lo}} to {{turnkey.hi}}, excluding VAT; the warm Shell Package without finishes would be {{shell.lo}} to {{shell.hi}}. Not included: the swimming pool, a septic tank and landscaping, and the covered terrace can move the final figure. The foundation and frame quantities in the breakdown need current market prices and a design to local codes. This is an indicative estimate: a free consultation with the architect turns it into an exact one.
